#!/bin/bash
# Shell script to count total number of files in all subdirectories of test_directory

total=0
for dir in test_directory/subdirectory_*; do
    count=$(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)
    total=$((total + count))
done

echo "Total number of files in all subdirectories: $total"
EOF
